caption: The drawing depicts a textile pattern featuring stylized botanical elements including large flowers, leaves, and stems arranged diagonally across the composition. The flowers and leaves are depicted in varying shades of blue, with some elements in deep navy and others in lighter blue or aqua, set against an off-white or beige background. The flowers are round with multiple petals or pointed with star-like shapes, and have circular centers with detailed dot patterns. The leaves are broad and irregularly shaped, containing lighter blue spots and outlined with dark blue or black. The main stem curves diagonally from the bottom left to the upper right, with smaller branches and tendrils extending outward. The background is plain and the texture of the cloth is visible, contributing a grid-like effect to the composition. Some fraying at the edges and small stains are present on the textile. There are faint, vertical bars of solid blue pattern on the left margin and handwritten text at the bottom right.
title: Resist Print
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
